questions.prompt: When the nearest wall is burning, the whole house dreads the flames.
questions.answer: Cum pariēs proximus ārdet, tōta domus flammās timet.

questions.prompt: Whenever men control their desires, firm friendship can be established.
questions.answer: Cum hominēs cupīdinibus imperābunt, firma amīcitia cōnfirmārī potest.

questions.prompt: When the farmer returns from the field, he will find the door shut.
questions.answer: Cum agricola ex agrō redībit, iānuam clausam inveniet.

questions.prompt: When the aged man hears the song, he will weep for joy.
questions.answer: Cum senex annōsus carmen audiet, gaudiō lacrimābit.

questions.prompt: When you dip the cloth in purple dye, it will become precious.
questions.answer: Cum pannum purpureō colōre tingēs, pretiōsus fiet.

questions.prompt: When the inhabitants approach the temple, they will offer gifts.
questions.answer: Cum incolae ad templum accēdent, dōna offerent.

questions.prompt: When you dig the metal out of the mountain, you will be rich.
questions.answer: Cum metallum ē monte effodiēs, dīves eris.

questions.prompt: Whenever the sky grows dark, the fishermen fear a storm.
questions.answer: Cum caelum obscūrātur, piscātōrēs tempestātem timent.

questions.prompt: Whenever the firmament shines with stars, the shepherd rejoices.
questions.answer: Cum firmāmentum stēllīs fulget, pāstor gaudet.

questions.prompt: Whenever harmonious citizens govern, the state flourishes.
questions.answer: Cum concordēs cīvēs regunt, cīvitās flōret.

questions.prompt: Whenever the physician grinds herbs in the mortar, a sweet smell rises.
questions.answer: Cum medicus herbās in mortāriō terit, dulcis odor surgit.

questions.prompt: When you praise the wicked, you injure the good.
questions.answer: Cum malōs laudās, bonōs laedis.

questions.prompt: When the soldiers flee, they confess their fear.
questions.answer: Cum mīlitēs fugiunt, timōrem suum fatentur.

questions.prompt: When you spare the guilty, you condemn the innocent.
questions.answer: Cum nocentibus parcis, innocentēs damnās.

questions.prompt: When you gaze at the flowing river, you will remember your homeland.
questions.answer: Cum flūmen fluēns aspiciēs, patriae tuae memineris.

questions.prompt: When the army, weary from the march, reaches the river, it will rest.
questions.answer: Cum exercitus itinere fessus ad flūmen perveniet, quiēscet.

questions.prompt: When you read the books of the ancients, you will learn wisdom.
questions.answer: Cum librōs veterum legēs, sapientiam discēs.

questions.prompt: When the victor enters the city, the joyful crowd will scatter flowers.
questions.answer: Cum victor urbem intrābit, laeta turba flōrēs sparget.

questions.prompt: When the senators keep silent in the senate-house, they approve the conspiracy.
questions.answer: Cum senātōrēs in cūriā tacent, coniūrātiōnem probant.

questions.prompt: Whenever men firmly control their desires, true friendship is strengthened.
questions.answer: Cum hominēs cupīdinibus fortiter imperant, vēra amīcitia cōnfirmātur.

questions.prompt: When you climb the high mountain, you will see the whole sea below.
questions.answer: Cum altum montem ascendēs, tōtum mare īnfrā vidēbis.

questions.prompt: When the maiden weaves the cloth, she will sing a sweet song.
questions.answer: Cum virgō tēlam texet, dulce carmen canet.

questions.prompt: When the storm ceases, the oarsmen will steer the ship to the harbor.
questions.answer: Cum tempestās cessābit, rēmigēs nāvem ad portum dīrigent.

questions.prompt: When you read this letter, then you will understand my grief.
questions.answer: Cum hanc epistulam legēs, tum dolōrem meum intellegēs.

questions.prompt: Whenever the leader boldly leads his troops, the soldiers follow willingly.
questions.answer: Cum dux cōpiās audācter dūcit, mīlitēs libenter sequuntur.

questions.prompt: Whenever the merchant returns from distant lands, he brings back new wares.
questions.answer: Cum mercātor ex terrīs longinquīs revertitur, novās mercēs refert.

questions.prompt: Whenever winter draws near, the birds seek warmer regions.
questions.answer: Cum hiems advenit, avēs regiōnēs calidiōrēs petunt.

questions.prompt: Whenever the orator's reputation grows, envy also increases.
questions.answer: Cum ōrātōris existimātiō crēscit, invidia quoque augētur.

questions.prompt: When you help the wretched, you honor the gods themselves.
questions.answer: Cum miserōs adiuvās, deōs ipsōs colis.

questions.prompt: When the general spares the conquered, he conquers a second time.
questions.answer: Cum victīs parcit, dux iterum vincit.

questions.prompt: The leader is outstanding both in war and in peace.
questions.answer: Dux cum in bellō tum in pāce praestat.

questions.prompt: Though the old man has always been brave, now he is stirred by a fresh hope.
questions.answer: Cum senex semper fortis fuerit, tum novā spē nunc commovētur.
